Method of Attack: Deploying ransomware payloads to encrypt systems
Exploiting zero-day vulnerability CVE-2023-0669 in GoAnywhere MFT for remote code execution
Exploiting Accellion FTA zero-day vulnerability to steal data
Discoverer: Huntress Threat Intelligence Manager Joe Slowik
Impacted Systems: High-profile companies including Shell, Kroger, Qualys, Stanford Medicine, University of Colorado, University of Miami, University of Maryland Baltimore (UMB), University of California
Attack Vector: Exploitation of zero-day vulnerability CVE-2023-0669 in GoAnywhere MFT via exposed administrative console
Exploitation of Accellion FTA zero-day vulnerability
Emails demanding ransom payments (in 2020 Accellion attacks)
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept exploit for CVE-2023-0669 released online
Unauthorized user accounts created on GoAnywhere MFTaaS instances
Shodan data showing over 1,000 GoAnywhere instances exposed online, 135 on vulnerable ports 8000 and 8001
